blocks.x: Grid operators balance physics, markets and regulation in real time: forecasting under intermittency, substation reliability, flexibility orchestration and CIP-grade security. The telemetry-to-decision loop is the core competency of the transition era.

Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.
